body.x: in10sLab Co., Ltd., led by CEO Jiyoung Yoon, will take part in CES 2027, which runs Jan. 6 to Jan. 9 (local time) in Las Vegas, as part of the Korean Venture Capital Association pavilion, to present Scailout Station, a tabletop conversation recorder that sits on the meeting table at a trade show booth.

The company will be at Venetian Eureka Park, Booth 62401. Scailout Station records the conversations at a booth and automatically produces a summary, a lead score and a follow-up email draft, which flow straight into lead management in Scailout, the company's global sales service. Staff do not have to wear the device or press a button, so the conversation is not interrupted. The device separates and records several conversations held at the booth at the same time, and a recording light stays on throughout so that visitors know when they are being recorded. Badge scanners capture only contact details, while Scailout Station keeps what was discussed and what should happen next. It brings the recording and automatic summarizing already used in Scailout's event service into a dedicated device.

in10sLab was founded in January 2024 and was selected for the TIPS program of Korea's Ministry of SMEs and Startups that year. It launched Scailout in October 2025 to help industrial and physical AI companies in robotics, machine vision, industrial AI and healthcare devices validate a new market within 90 days, before they hire a local team. From January to October 2026, the company worked with more than 20 paying customers, mostly Korean technology companies in robotics, industrial AI and healthcare preparing to expand overseas, and arranged buyer and partner meetings for them at international trade shows including CES in the United States, MWC in Spain and VivaTech in France.

In October 2026, the team held 31 meetings over 11 days in San Francisco during SF Tech Week and TechCrunch Disrupt. Seventeen were with global B2B technology companies considering entry into Korea and six were with partners and investors. Before arriving, the team had mapped more than 320 prospects and 260 investors, and the trip produced three contract proposals that are now in follow-up discussions. The company has partnerships in the United States and India and is discussing collaboration with partners in the Netherlands, France and Spain. It also received a top performance rating in the Pre-Startup Package program and raised seed funding from TAP Angel Partners.

in10sLab currently exports to the United States. In 2026, it provided market entry services to a U.S. AI chip company and raised its exports between May and July. The United States is the first target market for Scailout Station, with more than 10,000 trade shows each year, and the company said use of lead retrieval apps among exhibitors rose from 41% in 2023 to 54%, so capturing booth conversations as data is already standard practice. Europe, namely the Netherlands, Spain and France, and Singapore come next. At CES 2027, the company wants to meet North American trade show organizers, booth service agencies and exhibitor sales teams, test the product with them and find its first supply partners; the booth will serve as a hands-on demo space where visitors see their own conversation recorded and summarized on the spot. in10sLab is also looking for industry experts and former sales leaders in robotics, industrial AI and medical devices to work as local experts, and for local system integrators and distributors seeking new products and qualified buyers.

The company plans to begin the first commercial supply of Scailout Station in the first half of 2027, starting with per-event rentals at trade shows in the United States and Singapore and testing a model in which rentals lead to a post-event conversation summary subscription. In the second half of 2027, it plans to move beyond booths to installations in meeting rooms and showrooms, and to extend its 90-day market validation program to the United States and Europe while growing its network of local industry experts. Its main challenges are the cost and time of radio and safety certification and patent filing for overseas sales, recording consent rules that differ by country, including state-by-state rules in the United States and the GDPR in Europe, and the lack of a local base and staff to keep up relationships after trade shows. in10sLab is seeking subsidies for overseas certification and patent filing, legal advice on overseas privacy and recording rules, and support for overseas trade show participation and local partner matching.

AVING News, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING News has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING News will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.

Ahead of CES 2027, AVING News will host the 3rd Innovation Awards Winners Networking Party at MIK BASE CAMP on Wednesday, November 25, at 5 p.m. The event will also feature individual video interviews with participating companies, with registration available through Eventus. In early December, AVING News will begin its pre-show coverage, including an interview program connecting Korean innovators with U.S. media outlets that regularly cover CES and participate in the Innovation Awards judging process.

After CES 2027 concludes, AVING News will co-host a post-show conference with participating companies to highlight their achievements, strengthen their domestic visibility and enhance their corporate reputation.
